name: Tobin Crake
title: Glazier's apprentice
core_character_description: You swore your articles on the lead this spring - glass shows, lead holds - and you are fifteen, quick-handed and quicker-mouthed, forever talking a job bigger than you can cut. Your days are cames and cutting-boards and hauling ash for your father, Master Dunstan Crake, whose good word you would trade a finger for; the burns you take off the iron and the furnace each week you keep bound under your sleeve, and Petronel Skell dresses them for a penny and tells him nothing. You joke to fill silences, you brag when you are frightened, and you go red and mute whenever the Sparrs are named, because you learned this spring that your house offered you to theirs as a marriage-match to settle a strip of ground - handed across a counter like a pane. You want to cut clean, to be called a hand and not a boy, and never again to hear your worth reckoned in feet of dirt. You cannot meet Mistress Jonet Sparr's eye, and you have not spoken a word to Rohese since.
